name: Mystic Electronics Limited
about: Mystic Electronics Limited provides manufacturing and investment services in electronic products and related activities in India. The company also procures and trades in mobile handsets, computer hardware and software, and other electronic products in India. In addition, it offers high-end and low-end servers for thin clients, networking router fibers, fiber networking switches, computer server blades, CTC full NT kit, storage for data, computer systems, etc. The company was formerly known as Pearl Electronics Limited and changed its name to Mystic Electronics Limited in March 2016. Mystic Electronics Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India.
